chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch29 - The Stage Is Set: Li Huowang Confronts a Missing Past
chapter_meta_description: The troupe stops in a village to perform. Under the moonlight, Li Huowang looks into a bronze mirror and realizes he doesn't know his own age.
og_title: A Stranger in the Mirror - Chapter 29 of Dao Gui Yi Xian
og_description: Amidst an opera performance for a rural village, Li Huowang confronts the chilling loss of his identity as he stares at his own reflection.
twitter_title: Li Huowang doesn't recognize himself anymore. A quiet gut-punch of existential dread awaits in Ch29.
twitter_description: An opera stage, a bronze mirror, and a man who has forgotten how old he is. This chapter is the slow burn horror of losing yourself.
